installCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm install --prefix frontend; else npm install; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then npm run build --prefix frontend && rm -rf public-out && mkdir -p public-out && cp -a frontend/dist/frontend/browser/. public-out/; else npm run build && rm -rf public-out && mkdir -p public-out && cp -a dist/frontend/browser/. public-out/; fi
